children: Copper prices are higher in early Asian trading. Prices are supported by strong fundamentals and tightening inventories, ANZ research analysts say, adding that "Ongoing supply-side issues have been mounting in recent months." Chile, the world's largest copper producer, saw shipments sink to their lowest level in more than a year in August, they note. The three-month LME copper contract is 0.6% higher at $14,604.50 a ton.
